description.value: This Tim Hortons occupies the Library building at UBC Okanagan campus, offering the familiar Canadian staples of coffee, tea, baked goods, and sandwiches to the campus community and any visitors passing through. The website notes that line-ups are very common, reflecting its high traffic volume. As one of several food outlets managed by UBCO Food Services, it sits within a larger campus dining ecosystem.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: lockers (covered, secure) at 43m; wall_loops (covered) at 54m.
